cues: A spontaneous process happens on its own, without continuous help.
Many spontaneous processes give out heat.
Ice melts at room temperature, absorbing heat.
A gas spreads into a vacuum with no energy change at all.
And our cold pack absorbs heat.
So energy is not the only driving force.
text: A spontaneous process happens on its own, without continuous help. Many spontaneous processes give out heat. But not all. Ice melts at room temperature, absorbing heat. A gas spreads into a vacuum with no energy change at all. And our cold pack absorbs heat. So energy is not the only driving force.
